svg.title: Temperature Control with a Load Disturbance
svg.desc: Simulated temperature trajectories for P and PI using the lesson’s Euler method, with a load disturbance from 240 seconds.

g.text: Temperature Control with a Load Disturbance
Model values · Δt = 0.25 s · reference 4 K · disturbance from 240 s: −1 K
Numerical model, not measurements. PI approaches the reference again after the disturbance.
